Sure! To run an integrated regression (ireg) for a specific product, you’ll need to tell me which product you’re targeting. The available product codes are:

| Product Code | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| `fc`   | Full Chip |
| `starrc` | Star RC extraction |
| `pt`   | PrimeTime timing analysis |
| `nt`   | NanoTime timing analysis |

Once you let me know the product code, I can show you the exact command or even trigger the function for you. If you’re not sure which one applies to your bug, just give me a bit more context (e.g., “I’m debugging a timing issue” or “I need to re‑run the full chip simulation”), and I’ll help you pick the right one.
